subject: Quick check: security packet landed & pilot readiness
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Grace <sgrace@cloudvera.com>, Alex Moreno <amoreno@cloudvera.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check: security packet landed & next steps for CloudVera pilot

Hi Sofia / Alex —

Great conversation today — thanks for walking through the pilot goals and the traffic profile. Per our chat, I attached the Redwood SOC 2 packet and the mutual action plan so your security and procurement teams have everything in one place. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Assets shared: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_20270520.pdf (security evidence summary), CloudVera_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (high-level timeline & responsibilities)
- Can your security team confirm whether the SOC 2 artifacts are sufficient for an initial review?
- Proposed timeline: security review this week, procurement review next week, pilot onboarding the week after (target start: June 7). Does that align with your internal windows?
- If there are gaps, Grace (copied) can do a 15-min QA call to walk through any items in the packet.

Can you let us know which of these two are best to loop into the evidence review (legal/security contact + preferred date/time windows)? I’ll update the mutual action plan based on your timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_20270520.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
Attachment: CloudVera_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check: security packet landed & next steps for CloudVera pilot

Hi Sofia —

Just circling back on the SOC 2 packet I sent on Thursday. Hoping to lock the review window so we can keep to the pilot timeline we discussed. Quick yes/no is totally fine — are you seeing anything blocking from your side?

If it helps, Grace is available Monday afternoon (May 24) for a 15-min walk-through of the packet. Would you prefer a short screenshare or a Q&A call?

Thanks again — appreciate a heads up on priority.

Cheers,
Mateo

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check: security packet landed & next steps for CloudVera pilot

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the follow-ups and the packet. Apologies for the slow reply — I wanted to pull in our security lead before responding. Short update: 

- We got the SOC 2 packet and the MAP, and overall it looks comprehensive. A couple of small asks from our security reviewer: 1) a clearer list of data retention settings across Hosted vs Dedicated modes; 2) an example of audit log snippets (PII redaction example).
- Procurement also asked whether you have a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and an export-ready version of the MAP with finalized dates so they can align with vendor onboarding cadence.

We’re still interested in the pilot but will need those two items to make the risk review a quick pass.

Can Grace send the log snippet example and a short note on retention settings? If you can attach a DPA and a MAP with proposed dates by EOD Thursday (May 27), I’ll route to procurement and aim to get us scheduled for onboarding the week of June 7.

Appreciate the responsiveness — I’ll add a quick comment in the MAP once I see the updated file.

Best,
Sofia Grace
CloudVera — Senior Product Manager
sgrace@cloudvera.com
